Dramatic footage has captured the moment a pedestrian bridge in Camaligan, Philippines was rattled by Super Typhoon Fung-Wong. The typhoon has slammed ashore in the northeastern coast of the Philippines, where the massive storm had already left at least two people dead and forced more than a million people to relocate from flood- and landslide-prone areas, officials say.

The biggest typhoon to threaten the Philippines in years, Fung-wong could cover two-thirds of the archipelago with its 1800km-wide rain and wind band, forecasters said. #typhoon #supertyphoon #wildweather #bridge #Philippines
